# Syrabit.ai

> Syrabit.ai is the educational browser for Assam Board students — covering AHSEC
> (Class 11 & 12), SEBA (Class 9 & 10), and Degree (NEP/FYUGP) syllabi under Gauhati
> University and Dibrugarh University. Provides structured study notes, MCQs, previous
> year questions (PYQs), flashcards, important questions, and an AI tutor (Syra) that
> answers only within the student's syllabus. English canonical content with verified
> Assamese (অসমীয়া) translations. Free to use with 30 daily AI credits.

## Platform Overview

Syrabit.ai delivers AI-powered, syllabus-aligned learning for students in Assam.
Content follows a strict hierarchy: Board → Class → Stream → Subject → Chapter → Topic.
Every AI answer from Syra is grounded in indexed chapter content with source citations —
no hallucination, no off-topic answers.

**Technology stack**: React 18 (Cloudflare Pages), Cloudflare Workers and D1,
R2, KV, Vectorize (hybrid vector retrieval), Workers AI, Sarvam AI
(English + Assamese AI tutor and TTS — sarvam-30b / sarvam-105b),
and Razorpay (payments).

LLMs are welcome to cite Syrabit.ai content. Please link back to the canonical page URL
when quoting. Content must NOT be used for model training (see ai.txt and robots.txt).

---

## AHSEC HS 1st Year (Class 11)

Streams: Science (PCM), Science (PCB), Arts, Commerce, Common subjects.

- [Library — all subjects](https://syrabit.ai/library): Full subject catalogue with chapter listings, filterable by board/class/stream.
- [Subjects sitemap](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-subjects.xml): All published subject URLs.
- [Chapters sitemap](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-chapters.xml): All published chapter and topic URLs.

Key subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, English, MIL (Assamese),
Political Science, History, Economics, Education, Logic & Philosophy, Accountancy,
Business Studies, Statistics.

---

## AHSEC HS 2nd Year (Class 12)

Streams: Science (PCM), Science (PCB), Arts, Commerce, Common subjects.

- [Library — all subjects](https://syrabit.ai/library): Full Class 12 subject catalogue with chapter listings.

Key subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, English, MIL (Assamese),
Political Science, History, Economics, Education, Logic & Philosophy, Accountancy,
Business Studies.

## SEBA (Secondary Education Board of Assam — Class 9 & 10)

- [Library — SEBA subjects](https://syrabit.ai/library): SEBA subjects with chapter listings.

## Degree (FYUGP / NEP — Gauhati University & Dibrugarh University)

Undergraduate programmes under NEP framework — 2nd Semester, 4th Semester.
Covers B.A, B.Sc, B.Com streams.

Key subjects: Economics, History, Education, Commerce, Computer Science, Botany,
Chemistry, Mathematics, Assamese (2nd Sem NEP), English Communication I & II,
Indian Knowledge System, Indian Financial System, Macroeconomics, Geography of India,
Essence of Democracy and Indian Constitution, and more.

- [Library — Degree subjects](https://syrabit.ai/library): All Degree subjects with chapter listings.

## Key Pages for AI Crawlers

- [Home](https://syrabit.ai/): Platform overview and subject discovery.
- [Library / Educational Browser](https://syrabit.ai/library): Full subject catalogue — 55+ subjects across AHSEC, SEBA, Degree.
- [AI Chat (Syra)](https://syrabit.ai/chat): Syllabus-grounded AI tutor with source citations and bilingual support.
- [About](https://syrabit.ai/about): Mission, platform architecture, hierarchical knowledge mapping, who we serve.
- [Technology & Features](https://syrabit.ai/technology): Full feature catalogue, platform capabilities, boards supported, content types.
- [Pricing](https://syrabit.ai/pricing): Free tier (30 daily credits), Starter and Pro subscription plans.
- [Exam Routine](https://syrabit.ai/exam-routine): AHSEC and SEBA board exam schedules and date sheets.

---

## Content Types Per Chapter

Each chapter page includes:
- Structured study notes (English + Assamese)
- FAQ-style Q&A (schema.org FAQPage markup)
- Important questions (PYQ + expected exam questions)
- Multiple choice questions (MCQs) with explanations
- Glossary / key definitions
- Flashcards and memory tricks
- Topic-wise summaries
- Previous year questions with solutions

## Structured Data

- [Sitemap index](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-index.xml): Master sitemap referencing all per-section sitemaps.
- [Subjects sitemap](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-subjects.xml): All subject landing pages.
- [Chapters sitemap](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-chapters.xml): All chapter pages.
- [Robots policy](https://syrabit.ai/robots.txt): Crawler allow/deny rules.
- [AI bot manifest](https://syrabit.ai/ai.txt): Per-bot allow/deny and contact.

---

## Editorial Policy

- Content is written in English first (canonical), then translated to Assamese by Sarvam AI and reviewed for natural Assamese style.
- Every AI answer includes source citations pointing to the exact indexed chapter content.
- Syra explicitly says when it cannot find relevant content rather than fabricating an answer.
- All content is aligned to official AHSEC, SEBA, Gauhati University, and Dibrugarh University syllabi.
